messages:
mika: Quick sync — we need to finalize what runtime-level signals we send to the new dashboards for route health. Who can own schema / retention / backfill?

alex: I can take ownership of the exporter schema. Need exact field list and expected cardinality.

jamie: Eng-SRE — retention constraints: keep full per-request logs 7d in prod, aggregated metrics retained 365d. Backfill infra needs budgeting.

sara: Product/Console: dashboards want p50/p90/p99 latency per model+route, error rate, tokens/min, and cost per-minute. Also a sampled trace link for any sudden regressions. Filters: region + customer_tier.

tj: Runtime: can emit tags (model, route, shard, quant_profile). Need CPU budget on sidecar exporter. Suggest rollups at 1m/5m/1h.

mika: Proposal: runtime writes JSON events to kafka topic runtime-requests-v2, exporters forward to metrics pipeline. Aggregator will produce metrics into Prom + parquet rollups for long-term. Backfill window: rollup-level backfill up to 45 days; raw backfill only by request/paid SOW.

alex: Sounds right. Raw backfill is expensive. I'll spec rollup schema and enumerate which labels are high-cardinality.

jamie: SLO for ingestion lag: <5m end-to-end. Sampling policy: 10% traces for low-volume routes, 100% traces for routes with error rate > 1% or on canary.

sara: UX note: dashboards should be able to annotate rollouts automatically (rollout_id + canary boolean). Also need a compact view for top 10 cost-driving routes.

tj: Implementation sketch:
```
metric: runtime.latency_ms
labels: model,route,region,tier,rollout_id,quant_profile,prompt_length_bucket
aggregations: count,sum,p50,p90,p99 @ 1m,5m,1h
```

mika: Owners: alex -> schema + exporter PR, tj -> runtime emission + sidecar changes, jamie -> retention + backfill infra + runbook, sara -> dashboard wireframes + acceptance criteria.

alex: Created GH issue #2187 with initial schema draft and sample payloads: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/2187

tj: I'll open the runtime PR tomorrow, estimate ~3d of work for the emission + tests.

jamie: I'll draft a backfill plan and cost estimate. Preliminary: rollup backfill 45d =~ 2k compute hours on the cluster, need approval.

sara: Can we add a label for "customer_tier" so product can filter enterprise vs self-serve? Also want an explicit "canary=true" label so console auto-highlights.

tj: Agree on customer_tier. For prompt length, avoid raw ints — we should emit buckets: short/medium/long to limit cardinality.

mika: Decision: include prompt_length_bucket (short/medium/long) and drop raw prompt_length. Keep model+route+region+tier+rollout_id.

jamie: OK from SRE perspective. I'll also add retention enforcement in the pipeline (hard TTL for raw events).

sara: I'll mock the dashboard filters and annotation UI by EOD Thursday and share a short demo.

alex: Quick q: do we want to include quantization bitwidth as free-form label? that can explode cardinality.

tj: Use quant_profile with a small enumerated set (e.g., fp16, q4_0, q5_1) rather than raw bitwidth.

mika: Final call: quant_profile enumerated, prompt_length_bucket (3), retention: raw 7d, rollups 365d, rollup backfill 45d.

deploy-bot: Prod deploy started: runtime-exporter v2 -> prod :rocket:

alex: PR link posted in the GH issue and sample mapping attached.

jamie: I'll put the backfill runbook in the issue and add cost numbers for approvals.

sara: Can we add a short alert in console for high-cost routes (weekly spike)? I'll add an acceptance test.

mika: Great. Owners + tickets assigned. Next sync Friday 10:00am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
